jobs.title: Sr. Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Why TrueAccord?**

TrueAccord, a wholly owned subsidiary of TrueML, is a category-defining company. We combine machine learning with a human-based approach to transform debt resolution and to get people on the path towards financial health. Every year, more than 70 million Americans have negative experiences dealing with debt. We are changing this by providing personalized digital experiences that guide lenders and consumers through this challenging financial process.

With a world-class leadership team, passionate team members, and proprietary predictive models trained on years worth of transactional data, TrueAccord is well-positioned to deliver on a huge opportunity: helping millions of consumers to regain and keep their financial footing while lowering the cost of doing business for creditors across many industries.

### **About This Role:**

Join our Implementation team as a Sr. Implementation Specialist, a high-impact, execution-focused role built for a driven coordinator looking to launch a career in Technical Project Management. You will play a dual role: independently leading end-to-end onboarding for our smaller, standardized clients while providing essential organizational support for our largest Enterprise launches. Your ultimate goal is to ensure seamless, accurate client launches and keep complex implementation workflows moving smoothly on schedule.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Lead Growth Client Launches**: Independently manage the end-to-end onboarding for small-scale "Growth CSV" clients, executing fast, accurate, and repeatable short-term workflows.
* **Support Enterprise Implementations**: Partner closely with Senior Implementation Managers as their primary support lead, handling the organizational and logistical heavy lifting for complex, large-scale client launches.
* **Own Documentation & Governance:** Serve as the team's lead Document Manager by creating and maintaining RAIDS logs, project folders, and central document repositories.
* **Drive Project Momentum & Visibility:** Own daily and weekly task lists, escalate potential timeline risks early, orchestrate meetings with clear agendas, and distribute weekly status updates and action items.
* **Facilitate Cross-Functional Alignment:** Coordinate syncs and track deliverables across internal teams with sharp attention to detail, enabling senior leaders to stay focused on high-level strategy.

### **Who You Are:**

* **Aspiring Technical Project Manager:** Early-to-mid-career coordinator with foundational analytical skills who thrives in structured, repeatable workflows and is eager to grow into complex project management.
* **Detail-Oriented & Tactical:** Highly organized and reliable when executing clearly defined project tasks on tight timelines (days to weeks).
* **Strong Communicator & Collaborator:** Comfortable leading meetings, writing clear status updates, and aligning stakeholders across internal teams.
* **Coachable & Process-Minded:** Works well within established processes and proactively seeks guidance when encountering complex edge cases outside of standard playbooks.
* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. (No formal certifications like a PMP or regulatory background required; exposure to technical environments is a bonus!)

For U.S.-based hires, the overall base salary framework for this role currently spans **$80,000 to $90,000** per year. The applicable base salary range for any individual hire depends on the geographic labor market associated with the employee’s primary work location along with other factors such as relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.  
  
Geographic labor markets are divided into "tiers" based upon a number of factors, including cost of living. Below, you'll find a few example cities representative of each tiers:

* **U.S. Geo Tier 1** (i.e. San Francisco, New York City, Boston)
* **U.S. Geo Tier 2** (i.e.Austin, Denver, Phoenix)
* **U.S. Geo Tier 3** (i.e.Kansas City, Jacksonville, Indianapolis)

We encourage you to speak to your recruiter to learn more about our compensation philosophy as well as discuss our benefits, total rewards, and opportunities for growth.

### **What We Offer (Perks & Benefits)**

* Flexible vacation
* Medical/dental/vision insurance
* Traditional/Roth retirement savings options
* Company-paid disability and life insurance
* Flexible Spending Account & Limited FSA
* Family-friendly parental leave, volunteer and voting time off
* On-demand wellness platform access for you and 5 friends and family
* PerkSpot discount program for 900+ merchants nationwide
  

### **Recruiting Fraud Notice:**

We’re aware of fraudulent recruiters posing as TrueAccord or TrueML and contacting job seekers. To protect yourself, here’s how our real hiring process works:

* **Official channels only.** Our recruiters email only from @trueaccord.com [If you’ve received an InMail, you should verify the recruiter’s @trueaccord.com email]

* **No payments or financial info during hiring.** We will never ask you to pay fees, buy equipment, or share banking information during the hiring process.

* **No text or chat-app interviews.** We do not conduct interviews by text message or messaging apps.

* **No “portals” or access keys.** We do not send PDF portals or access keys, or ask for passwords or login credentials.

* **No resume services.** We will never require an “ATS-friendly” resume rewrite or recommend paid resume services.

If someone contacting you on our behalf does any of the above, it is fraud.

**Stay safe:**

* Don’t open attachments, click links, or share personal information.
* Report the message as phishing to your email provider, and report fake profiles to LinkedIn.
* Not sure? Verify by emailing recruiting@trueaccord.com before responding.

**If you’ve already shared information with suspected scammers:** Contact your bank, visit identitytheft.gov, and report the fraud at reportfraud.ftc.gov or ic3.gov.

### **Remote Work, Travel Expectations, & Physical Requirements**

This role supports a global, cross-functional business and operates primarily in a Remote-First environment. However, flexibility outside of standard business hours and occasional local or international travel may be necessary for global operations support, company meetings, training, offsites, and collaborative projects.

This position primarily involves computer-based work, requiring extended periods at a computer, participation in virtual meetings, and use of standard office technology. We will consider reasonable accommodations to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

Maintaining a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment is expected. The ability to protect confidential company, employee, customer, and business information while working outside of a company office is also required.

  

### **Personally Identifying Information**

We collect personal information for employment purposes. We do not sell personal information. Most of the information we have is provided to us by you and/or collected as part of the employment process. For more details on how we use, share, and delete personal information see our Privacy Policy.

  

### **Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse and inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions and this makes us stronger every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

The Associate Implementation Specialist is responsible for assisting a Karmak customer to seamlessly and productively implement the Karmak business system from first engagement to after the Bring Live. The Associate Implementation Specialist must be able to set up and train on one specific major module, as well as to be able to convert data for setup, sandbox and Bring Live. The Associate Implementation Specialist also must be able to complete Branch Adds, Module Adds and Merger/Acquisition setup and training for their specific module.

* Guide and assist customers through the transition from their previous business system to Fusion by providing the following:
  + Enterprise and Business Strategy/Data Discussion calls. Includes explanation of data load-sheet requirements
  + Converting setup, sandbox and live data and communicating necessary changes and feedback to the customer
  + Configuring the new Karmak business system with input from the customer
  + Webinar training prior to Bring Live

    - Recap emails

  + Notifying the Resource Coordinator or Operations Coordinator of any time or additional meetings which need to be scheduled
  + Maintaining communication with the customer and internal teams regarding needs and status of the assigned
  + Completing all documentation, cases and follow up items related to the assigned as process documents
  + Seeking out necessary resources to discuss any business-process related issues/items which may present themselves during the process
  + Conducting webinar training and/or remote/onsite training based on assigned services
* Conduct additional services webinars for existing customer base
* Understand Karmak's implementation process and the departments that impact that process
* Able to work with each of the necessary departments in a positive and accountable manner
* Understand Karmak's Branch Add, Module Add and Merger/Acquisition processes and the departments involved in those services. Able to work with each of the departments positively and professionally
* Be able to understand Salesforce and how it relates to Implementation Services projects. Able to find customer information and to read and understand all applicable documentation (Sales orders, cases, etc.). Able to professionally complete assigned cases and to close those cases within set timeframe.
* Have a basic understanding of business processes and their impact on the setup of the Karmak business system software
* Adherence to all Department and Team policies and processes as identified in written SOP documents

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

* Valid US Driver's License
* Ability to travel inside and outside of the United States
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products - Outlook, Word, Excel
* Basic understanding of Karmak-licensed AI tools and comfortability in their usage
* Ability to learn at least one major module of Karmak software
* Ability to complete data load-sheet conversations and to complete data conversions
* Ability to learn and work both independently and within the framework of a team
* Basic understanding of the business and industry of our customers
* Basic knowledge of various learning styles and how to apply them
* Customer service skills. Ability to maintain a professional attitude
* Ability to maintain focus and be detail oriented
* Have excellent time management and organizational skills
* Be able to work well within the framework of a team and to follow documented processes and procedures
* Possess exceptional communication skills
* Ability to accept and build on constructive criticism, both from team members and from customers
* Assume ownership and accept responsibility for all actions

Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. *PLEASE NOTE: This is a clinical training position which requires a valid Registered Nurse license and dedicated experience as a* *clinical trainer. If you do not have these requirements, please review our other open job opportunities to determine if there is a better fit for your skills and experience. Thank you!*

  

The **Clinical Training Specialist, Medical Review Audit (RN)** owns the design, development, and delivery of post acute training programs for clinical audit staff specializing in Inpatient Psychiatric Facility (IPF), Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility (IRF), Home Health and DME claims. This is not a generalist training role. The right candidate brings deep, working knowledge of IPF and IRF documentation standards, payment systems, and medical necessity criteria alongside a demonstrated track record of building training programs that produce measurable improvements in auditor accuracy, productivity, and quality outcomes. This role requires an active nurse who can function as both a clinical subject matter expert and a skilled adult learning practitioner.

**Key Responsibilities to include:**

**Training Program Design & Development**

* Design, build, and maintain comprehensive training curricula for clinical audit nurses and audit associates covering post acute claim review, documentation requirements, medical necessity criteria, coding, and payer policy.
* Develop structured training programs, job aids, reference materials, and assessment tools for new hire onboarding, ongoing competency, performance improvement, and new program implementations.
* Translate complex clinical, regulatory, and payer-specific requirements into clear, audit-ready training content appropriate for the intended audience — including IPF PPS, IRF PPS, DSM-5 diagnostic criteria, level of care distinctions, and facility-specific billing rules, and other relevant training.
* Maintain and update training materials on a continuous basis to reflect changes in CMS payment rules, LCD/NCD policy, coding guidelines, and client-specific requirements affecting IPF and IRF audits.
* Build and manage training content within the Learning Management System (LMS); ensure materials are current, accessible, and structured for effective delivery in a remote environment.

**Training Delivery & Outcomes**

* Plan, coordinate, and deliver new hire training and ongoing education across 1:1, small group, and virtual classroom formats.
* Track and report training completion, assessment scores, and post-training performance metrics (audit accuracy, QA results, appeals outcomes); use data to evaluate program effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
* Identify training gaps through QA results, audit performance data, appeals trends, and direct observation; develop and execute targeted remediation plans.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing on new audit platform workflows and reporting enhancements; incorporate findings into training materials before go-live.
* Deliver training on new client implementations, new audit programs, and updated audit concepts in coordination with operations and management.

**Clinical Subject Matter Expertise**

* Serve as the primary subject matter authority for IPF audit training, including: inpatient psychiatric medical necessity criteria (vs. PHP and IOP level of care), qualifying DSM-5 diagnoses, physician certification and attestation requirements, daily progress note standards, treatment plan documentation, safety and risk assessment requirements, and ECT add-on billing under IPF PPS.
* Serve as the primary subject matter authority for IRF audit training, including: the 60%/75% compliance rule and qualifying conditions, pre-admission screening, post-admission physician evaluation timelines, IRF-PAI completion requirements, 3-hour therapy rule documentation (including exceptions), weekly interdisciplinary team conference requirements, individualized plan of care standards, and CMG assignment logic.
* Maintain current, working knowledge of IPF PPS and IRF PPS payment rules, ICD-10-CM/PCS coding applicable to inpatient psychiatric and rehabilitation claims, DRG and CMG assignment, and mental health parity compliance requirements.
* Monitor changes to CMS regulations, LCD/NCD coverage criteria, coding guidelines, and clinical standards; proactively update training content and communicate changes to audit staff.
* Provide consultative input on audit platform requirements, workflow design, and business rule development as they relate to IPF and IRF audit processes.

**Collaboration & Program Support**

* Partner with operations management, QA, and compliance to align training programs with business objectives and client contractual requirements.
* Support management in documenting workflows and process improvement plans; contribute to training-related components of new concept implementation.
* Provide input on training scheduling to ensure delivery meets operational timelines, legal requirements, and contractual obligations.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Deep working knowledge of IPF payment and documentation requirements: IPF PPS, qualifying psychiatric diagnoses and DSM-5 criteria, medical necessity standards for inpatient psychiatric care, physician certification requirements, treatment plan and daily progress note standards, safety assessment documentation, and ECT add-on billing.
* Strong command of IRF coverage and documentation requirements: IRF PPS, qualifying conditions under the 60%/75% compliance rule, pre-admission screening, IRF-PAI completion timelines, 3-hour therapy rule and exceptions, interdisciplinary team conference documentation, FIM scoring context, and CMG assignment.
* Ability to distinguish and articulate medical necessity criteria across levels of care: inpatient psychiatric vs. PHP/IOP; IRF vs. SNF — and train auditors to apply those distinctions accurately and consistently.
* Proficiency with ICD-10-CM/PCS coding for inpatient psychiatric and rehabilitation claims; working knowledge of DRG and CMG assignment logic.
* Demonstrated ability to design and deliver adult learning programs that produce measurable, documented outcomes in a clinical or healthcare audit production environment.
* Proficiency with instructional design principles, needs assessment methodology, and learning evaluation frameworks (e.g., Kirkpatrick model).
* Experience developing and managing training content in a Learning Management System (LMS).
* Strong data interpretation skills; able to analyze QA results, audit accuracy metrics, and appeals data to assess training effectiveness and identify gaps.
* Familiarity with utilization management tools such as MCG or InterQual, particularly criteria applicable to inpatient psychiatric and rehabilitation level of care determinations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (intermediate to advanced PowerPoint, Word, and Excel); experience with curriculum development or e-learning authoring tools preferred.
* Clear, precise communicator who can translate technical clinical and billing content for audiences with varying levels of experience.

**Required Qualifications**

* Active, unrestricted nursing license in good standing; not sanctioned or excluded from the Medicare program by OIG.
* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Health Information Management, Education, or a related field required.
* **3+ years of direct experience performing medical record audits in post acute claims (IPF and/or IRF, Home Health, DME claims) in a payer or similar audit organization is required**; experience across all or most post acute segments is strongly preferred.
* 3+ years of experience developing and delivering clinical or healthcare training programs with documented, measurable outcomes; remote learning delivery required.
* Demonstrated experience identifying training gaps from performance data and implementing remediation programs with evidence of improvement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Nursing, Education, Health Informatics, or a related field.
* AHIMA or AAPC coding certification preferred (CPC, CCS, CCS-P, RHIT, or equivalent).
* Direct clinical experience in an inpatient psychiatric or inpatient rehabilitation setting preferred; this experience must be reflected in the candidate's nursing background, not only their audit history.
* Clinical background in inpatient psychiatric nursing, including familiarity with psychiatric assessment tools (PHQ-9, Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale, etc.), treatment planning, and level of care criteria.
* Clinical background in inpatient rehabilitation nursing, including familiarity with FIM scoring, functional goal-setting, and IRF care coordination.
* Experience with mental health parity compliance review or behavioral health utilization management in a payer or audit context.
* Prior experience in a RAC, MAC, TRICARE, or commercial payer audit environment focused on inpatient facility claims.
* Experience conducting User Acceptance Testing on audit platform or reporting system enhancements.
* Experience contributing to provider education, audit edit development, or medical policy improvement for IPF or IRF programs.

Loancrate builds AI-native tooling to automate mortgage workflows. Our ultimate goal is fully automated origination, which has the potential to save lenders over $16B in operating expense per year.

Since starting in 2020, our remote team has enabled our customers to power >$85 billion in new home loans. We care about collaboration, very open communication covering the good & the bad so that we learn from our decisions quickly, and ultimately having fun while we're building. You'll fit in well if you like diving deep quickly!

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Buying a new loan origination system is the easy part. Actually configuring it to match how a lender runs its business - their conditions, their disclosures, their underwriting guidelines, their quirks - is where implementations are won or lost. We're looking for an Implementation Consultant to be the person in the room (virtually or on-site) who makes that configuration work actually happen.

This is a forward-deployed, hands-on role. You'll work directly with a lender's team during the implementation phase to configure Loancrate around their workflows, answer their configuration questions, and get them through user acceptance testing. Once the customer is live, you roll off and move to the next implementation - the CSM stays on as the long-term relationship owner, and the Implementation Lead keeps the overall project plan on track, while you're the one actually in the product with the customer making it work.

Because this role sits inside an active mortgage workflow from day one, you need to already be fluent in mortgage - not learning it as you go. We can teach you Loancrate inside and out. What we can't do in any reasonable timeframe is teach you what a lender's processors and underwriters actually need a system to do for them.

This is a foundational role on a team we're building from scratch: you'll help define what "good configuration" looks like, build the muscle memory for how we implement lenders quickly and correctly, and be one of the people whose work most directly determines whether a customer's go-live goes smoothly.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Act as the forward-deployed implementation expert - work directly with the customer's team to configure Loancrate around their specific workflows, conditions, and business rules.
* Translate a lender's current-system setup into a Loancrate configuration - take how they operate today and recommend (and build) the configuration that gets them the same outcome, or better, in Loancrate.
* Own testing support during UAT - respond to configuration and testing questions as they come in, and work the "UAT Blocked" queue in Jira so customer-reported blockers get resolved quickly instead of sitting.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues in real time - when something isn't behaving the way the customer expects, you're the one who can dig in, find the root cause, and fix it or escalate it clearly.
* Work closely with the Implementation Lead and CSM - you're heads-down on configuration and testing; they're managing the timeline and the broader relationship, and you keep them informed of anything that could affect either.
* Roll off cleanly at go-live - document the final configuration and any open items clearly enough that the CSM can pick up the relationship without a gap.
* Help build the implementation playbook - common configuration patterns, frequently asked setup questions, and testing checklists that make the next implementation faster than the last.
* Willingness to travel - expect approximately once-a-month domestic US travel to customer sites, with occasional additional trips around key milestones like UAT kickoff and go-live.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Within your first 90 days, you will:

* Be the hands-on configuration owner on at least one active implementation, trusted by the customer to answer setup questions directly.
* Have cleared UAT-Blocked tickets at a pace that keeps testing moving rather than stalling on your queue.
* Have handled a real configuration curveball - a workflow that doesn't map cleanly to Loancrate - and worked it to a resolution the customer was happy with.
* Have a direct working relationship with your Implementation Lead and CSM, with a clear handoff process for when you roll off a project.

By the 12-18 month mark, you'll have implemented multiple lenders end-to-end, be a go-to resource for tricky configuration scenarios, and be a candidate to help train and ramp future Implementation Consultants as the team grows.

**Required Skills and Background**
----------------------------------

* **Direct mortgage experience** - you've worked at a lender or mortgage tech company and understand the origination-to-closing lifecycle (1003, LE, CD, AUS findings, conditions, lock extensions) well enough to configure a system around it without hand-holding.
* **Hands-on experience with a loan origination system** (Encompass, Empower, Byte, or similar) - you've worked inside one, ideally helped configure or administer one, and know where lenders' real-world workflows get tricky.
* **Comfort working hands-on in software configuration** - you're not afraid to get into settings, rules, and workflows yourself rather than just describing what needs to change to someone else.
* **Testing and troubleshooting instincts** - you can read a bug report or a UAT ticket, reproduce the issue, and tell the difference between a configuration fix, a training gap, and an actual product bug.
* **Clear, patient communication** - you'll be answering the same category of question from different customers constantly, and need to do it clearly and without making anyone feel behind.
* **Comfort with a project-phase role** - you're energized by the intensity of an implementation and the clean handoff at the end, rather than wanting to own the long-term relationship.
* **Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity** - we're building this function from the ground up; you'll be figuring out the right way to configure something as often as you're executing a known pattern.
* **Curiosity about AI and how it's changing mortgage workflows** - you don't need an ML background, but you should be excited to help configure and explain AI-driven features to customers.
* **Proactive, independent workstyle** - you keep plans, trackers, agendas, and follow-ups moving without needing someone to remind you; when a decision is needed, you bring the relevant context and options to the right person.

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

* Robust medical coverage (100% of employee + family premiums covered)
* Vision & dental coverage
* 401(k)
* HSA / FSA
* Access to lender partner’s employee loan program
* Remote-first culture - work from wherever you do your best work
* Flexible time off - we trust you to manage your time

*Loancrate is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

Compensation Range: $130K - $180K
